QUOTE: "In the library: no thread is created. The only spawn sites the index finds are in sample programs" and "`mbedtls_threading_key_slot_mutex` ... `threading.c`" with "Everything in `library/threading.c` sits behind those gates."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says no thread is created in the library, and it also says library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (`mbedtls_mutex_lock`, the threading mutexes) that threaded callers use when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled.
